file: MN k12 social science and studies 2021.pdf
structure: Minnesota 2021 K-12 social studies standards. Front matter (intro, organization, how to read), anchor standards by strand (5 strands: 1 Citizenship and Government, 2 Economics, 3 Geography, 4 History, 5 Ethnic Studies; 25 numbered standards), and the HS era lists. Then one table per grade (K, 1-8) and per HS strand (grades 9-12 band, written as grade '9' in code), with columns Grade | Strand | Standard | Code | Benchmark. Codes are grade.strand.standard-number.benchmark (e.g. 3.1.4.1; HS 9.4.18.1 where History benchmarks begin with 'World History Era n' or 'U.S. History Era n'). Each table row repeats grade/strand/standard text, so every table cell is a standard; grade headings precede each grade's tables. No course-based content: HS is one band by strand, tables continue across pages with repeated header rows. No examples or teacher notes.
